scope: Read-only review of newly added actual-Adam branch execution in run_effect.py and effect_common.py, plus directly used runtime/operator contracts. No real-model execution or old F numerical tests were performed.

checks.evidence: runtime.INIT_CP is track_contrast_v2/training/FRAME/run/snapshot_2304.pth. initialize asserts step=2304, condition=FRAME, exact trainable-name list, 14593 trainable scalars, all 28 Adam states at step2304, settings equal original CALIBRATION. Optimizer state uses deepcopy and exact state hash after load.

Every pair and every condition reloads model_state_dict and a fresh deepcopy of optimizer_state_dict, then zero_grad(set_to_none=True). Parameter reference vector theta is captured once from F2304. Updates are not accumulated across conditions or pairs.
Python random, NumPy, torch CPU and all visible CUDA RNG states are captured and reset for each condition. Full state digest is checked before step and after deterministic forward measurements.

checks.item: Unchanged scalar F and controlled deletions
checks.evidence: compute delegates original det/keep/C to v1 loss_terms and FRAME readout to v2 temporal_risk_loss. full_F retains original (det + weighted_keep + weighted_track) + weighted_frame order; no_keep/no_track omit only their corresponding weighted scalar. Real branch gradients are autograd of these scalars, not a substitute grouped sum.

checks.item: Fixed parameter coordinates and unused values
checks.evidence: Single model.named_parameters order filtered by requires_grad is used throughout. autograd allow_unused=True returns None and assignment retains None. Zero padding is confined to read-only diagnostic vectors and ConFIG combination with a joint usage mask.

Independent fit/weighted_keep/weighted_track gradients are checked against original full_F at rtol1e-4, atol2e-7. Both norms and L2 discrepancy are recorded. ConFIG norm control is explicitly its sequential grouped sum, with original scalar full_F retained for comparison.

checks.item: Actual Adam effect and state progression
checks.evidence: Each branch executes optimizer.step once; measured delta is actual post-step parameters minus common F2304 theta. Records include update norm/cosine, gradient dot delta, optimizer and model hashes. Used parameters must advance to2305 and true unused parameters stay2304.

Same runtime freezes all except original TPro/conv_out1/conv_out2 and keeps model.eval. Frozen state and BN buffers are hashed before and after each condition. New files add no trainable model parameters.
Observer batch is never passed to compute/autograd; it is evaluated only under no_grad before and after each branch. Pair distinctness and cohort selection are separately owned by data audit.

Real config mode asserts OPERATOR_CHECK.status=CONFIG_SINGLE_STEP_AUTHORIZED. It maps groups to exact fit/keep/track keys, calls official wrapper and keeps its detailed operator/fallback diagnostics. No real ConFIG step was executed by this review.

frozen_check validates registered new and reused hashes on entry/exit. Old v1/v2 caches are input/label/aux-input fingerprint checked. Freeze manifest itself is pending parent completion before any real measurements.

limits: This is static execution review, not runtime validation. Actual assertions and finite-output checks remain to run after protocol freeze.
effect_data.py and PAIR_PLAN.json were not yet present when this review began; cohort definitions, observation alignment, and plan distinctness remain the independent data-agent review scope.
Input gradient norm matching does not guarantee equal actual Adam update norm or beneficial target changes; these are recorded measurements, not assumptions.
